name: semantic-style-roles
goal: Application styles are selected by their purpose; Styles shows real semantic variable assignments and changing a role updates its consumers across Reports Desktop and Hub

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.

Prior Styles assertions covered palette grouping but never required semantic variable declarations or role reassignments.
